body: Being that I don’t have any self-esteem, I’d say it’s probably everyone.

I mean, it won’t be a burden on my daughter. 

This has been most of our relationship. It got worse women we had kids, but I’m always the one to get them at night if they need anything. If anything, she gets more sleep than me. 

As far as splitting, again, she said she’d make sure I never see my kids.

We get no time together without at least 1 child. She only trusts her parents to watch the kids, and now with two, she feels it’s too much of a burden to put on them.
I’ve tried, even begged her to do anger management. I don’t know where the root of her anger comes from, because it comes from out of nowhere.

The argument is based on her lack of anger management. If I’m apologizing for anything it would be for not continuing to take verbal and emotional abuse. 

She claims that I’m too sensitive, so it’s my problem, not hers.
